regressionChallenges: Separate provider endpoints remain parallel (the production scan completes a two-endpoint fixture barrier).
Shared 503 stays unavailable/unverified for every alias.
Weak-pointer lifetime regression proves complete payload leaves the temporary registry after its final consumer.
Later forced read uses transport again instead of retaining the old completed result.
Existing exact identity, 304, redirect, rate-limit, payload, game and loader regression tests all passed.

Independent review identified a public Observation value-type compatibility regression. Resolved in 23dab1b2fa2054ce485904a13acee056b6641916 by restoring Value and moving Arc sharing into private HttpContext; final full suite, strict lint, benchmark and compiled live smoke passed.
limitations: No Windows WebView2, MO2 runtime, installer or user desktop was exercised.
This is tested branch code, not a new released Windows binary.
Original X post could not be opened directly; repository list comes from matching indexed attributed copies.
Sequential benchmark timing does not prove a universal latency improvement.
Concurrent request reduction requires overlapping reads. Non-overlapping forced reads still perform their normal conditional requests; final live alias sample explicitly demonstrates this boundary.
Rust 1.99.1 CI pin was not available locally; all recorded native gates used Rust 1.100.0.
